paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure, titled "Distribution of Errors with GPT-4," is a donut chart illustrating the breakdown of error types observed in a single run of GPT-4 across all tasks in the TuringBench benchmark. The chart categorizes the outcomes into six distinct error types, each represented by a colored segment with a corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "Incorrect" responses, accounting for 43.6% of the total. The second largest, in red, is "Correct" at 31.6%. Other categories include "Partial" (yellow, 11.3%), "Syntax Error" (green, 2.3%), "Unknown" (orange, 8.3%), and "Bad Response" (light blue, 1.5%). Each category is labeled with a line connecting the text to its respective segment, clearly showing the proportion of each error type in the overall performance. The chart effectively visualizes the dominance of incorrect responses and the significant proportion of correct ones, with the remaining categories making up smaller, but still notable, portions of the error distribution.
